author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers exploit Plex2Shell flaws to install crypto miners and proxy software. Admins should update their Plex Media Server. But when a server is exposed to the internet and runs vulnerable software, it can become an entry point for attackers who […]
title: Plex2Shell Exploit Used to Turn Vulnerable Plex Servers Into Crypto Miners

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Meta wants the right to scrape your website for AI training. If you have a business account, that includes you. author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: The UK Electoral Commission is building an AI system to alert candidates to damaging deepfakes within three hours. The UK’s Electoral Commission is building an AI-powered system to tell candidates about significant deepfakes within three hours of posting. Its chief executive, Vijay Rangarajan, said so at a panel at the Conservative Party’s annual conference last […]
title: Deepfakes and Election Manipulation: UK Watchdog Seeks Faster Detection

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: OpenBSD flaws, including a 37-year-old BSD bug, enable local attackers to bypass security protections and gain root access. Patches are available. Cybersecurity firm Calif published a full exploit and write-up this week for a local privilege escalation on OpenBSD 7.9 that chains two separate kernel flaws, one of them a 37-year-old integer overflow inherited from […]
title: Big Fish: OpenBSD Root Exploit Chains a 37-Year-Old BSD Bug With a Kernel Flaw

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers stole ConnectWise application credentials to access Microsoft 365 tenants, prompting the company to suspend cloud services. ConnectWise suspended its Cloud Backup service and took both SaaS Security and Cloud Management offline over the weekend after discovering that unknown attackers had obtained unauthorized access to seven of its application identities. title: Attackers Abuse Stolen ConnectWise Application Credentials to Target Microsoft 365

author: Pierluigi Paganini

title: Japan’s SiteGuard WAF flaw CVE-2026-106931 is already being exploited

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A Broadcom Wi-Fi flaw dating back to 2010 allows attackers within Wi-Fi range to execute code on vulnerable routers without authentication. Researcher Quentin Kaiser presented a talk at Hexacon in Paris documenting a vulnerability in Broadcom’s proprietary 802.11 implementation that has been present in their SDK since at least 2010. title: 16-Year-Old Broadcom Wi-Fi Bug Lets Attackers Take Over Routers Without a Password
